The program prepares students for an entry-level position in a dental office. PRICE $2,500* DURATION 9 weeks Ask about this course 916-888-9821 9 weeks Start a dental career in 9 weeks Who is it for? New students seeking entry-level dental assisting training. Prerequisites None. Students must be 16 or older. What students get at the end Dental assisting training with chairside experience, completion of a 64-hour internship component, and help getting hired: the team helps with your resume and job applications, and graduates can use the academy's private job board, where local dental offices post openings. Help getting hired Dental offices need trained assistants, and our team helps you through the hiring process when you finish. We help with your resume and job applications, and local dental offices post openings for our graduates on our private student and alumni job board. “After completing the program I had multiple job offers.” — Amanda Lehr, Google review Format Lectures, homework, chairside experience, and assigned externship hours. Ask admissions to confirm lecture delivery for your selected class. Best next step Download the registration form and call the office at 916-888-9821 to enroll or schedule a tour. Choose the right training path This Roseville program costs $2,500 for 9 weeks · 210 hours. It combines coursework and chairside training with a 64-hour internship, plus resume and job-application support. What does completing the program mean? The program prepares you for an entry-level dental assistant role. Completing this training does not itself issue a California Registered Dental Assistant license or qualify you as a dental hygienist. RDA applicants must meet the Board's current pathway and examination requirements. What should I confirm before enrolling? Ask admissions what is included in tuition, which individual certificates are included or separate, any materials or other costs, and how your selected class day and assigned internship day fit your schedule. Job assistance supports your search; employment is not guaranteed.
